feed_summary: Abstract We give an exposition for a principle of gatekeeper asymmetry doom in information security, which states that “If the system vetting adversarial input has strictly less power than the system processing that input, without leveraging some hard problem, this will inevitably lead to doom.” We list a variety of examples where one can see […] The post 30 Years of Gatekeeper Asymmetry Doom: The Paradox that Makes Powerful LLMs More Vulnerable appeared first on Check Point Research .
title: 30 Years of Gatekeeper Asymmetry Doom: The Paradox that Makes Powerful LLMs More Vulnerable
